findings.message: Stage 3 (module-kernel-guard-v2) and stage 4 (migrate-chats-profile) manifests remain pinned to main@d79de677 and will need their own dev refreeze before launch; outside this package's scope and does not affect disjointness.

requirementFit.summary: REQ-KERNEL maps to AC-KERNEL-1/AC-KERNEL-2, evidence receipts EV-KERNEL-1/EV-KERNEL-2, workstream ownership and final audit gates.

implementationQuality.summary: WS-KERNEL write set (Router/Store/Block plus their tests) is disjoint from stages 1, 3 and 4; requirements are executable on current code (withStore lives in Store.ts, EventBus.off exists, main.ts stays untouched while preserving the use() signature); the guard debt map is excluded from writes and explicitly forbidden.

evidenceQuality.summary: Focused test command is shell-safe after quoting, evidence routes match artifactRoot, and teardown semantics (unsubscribe after destroy, unmounted blocks receive no updates) are observable in AC-KERNEL-1 and SEC-LIFECYCLE.

residualRisk.summary: Round-1 CHANGES_REQUIRED findings (stale main base mention in developer-overview.md, unquoted grep pipeline hazard) and the advisory forbiddenWrites entry are confirmed resolved in revision 3; one Low roadmap follow-up remains advisory.

summary: Independent two-round read-only audit of revision 3. Round 1 returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with two Medium findings (stale `main` base in developer-overview.md, unescaped pipe in the focused grep command) and one advisory (explicit guard-script forbiddenWrites); revision 3 closed all three and the delta beyond them is exactly the declared refreeze set (planRevision, runId, dev@12d37ccd baseline, launchGate, leadOwned, compatibility.baseFrontend, review wiring). Requirements, acceptance, evidence, budgets and the six-path write set are byte-identical to revision 1. Round 3 closed a compile-blocker found at freeze time: `workstreams[0].artifactPaths` converted from a bare array to the ALK 2.15 result/review templates under the same evidence root (same class of fix as the backend-skeleton r2-to-r3 refreeze); no requirement, acceptance, evidence, budget or write-set change. Revision 5 adds one controller-owned leadOwned path (docs/progress/2026-10-05-handoff.md) so the ownership audit classifies every path in the implementation delta; no other change. Verdict: READY_TO_FREEZE.
